purpose: adjudicate worker-067 F1 (protocol 3.4 vs constant-CFL certified order claim)

C2_protocol_section_3_4.paragraph: Spatial order is measured with a fixed, small `dt` (`1e-4`) so RK4 error is negligible; temporal order is measured separately by fixing `h` and refining `dt` (`dt ∝ h` runs are reported as mixed-order and never quoted as spatial).

C3_certified_order_claim.statement: For the flat-space spherical scalar-wave calibration on the pinned configuration (Gaussian pulse, psi = r*phi reduction, Dirichlet walls at r=0 and r=30, t_end=6, cfl=0.5, L2-integral error norm), the spatial discretisation is second order: p = 2.0 within the declared band |p - 2| <= 0.3, certified at FOUR rungs (dr = 0.2/0.1/0.05/0.025) for each of three methodologically independent schemes, and replicated across schemes within the R5 agreement rule.
schemes: lffd — independent reference-family control: explicit leapfrog time integration + 3-point central finite differences. NOT the scheme under test; it is the reference the other two are compared against.
cnfd — independent scheme 1: implicit Crank-Nicolson (trapezoidal) time integration + 3-point central finite differences.
cnfem — independent scheme 2: implicit Crank-Nicolson time integration + consistent-mass P1 finite elements.

temporal_control.note: if halving dt moves the error, the measured order is temporal, not spatial

E1_fixed_dr_dt_refinement._rule: temporal subdominant iff max relative error change per dt halving < 2%

verdict.w067_mitigation_claim: temporal subdominance is measured by controls, so no number changes - scope the text in rev 4
verdict.reading: C1-C4: the certified 4-rung order claim is measured at cfl=0.5 (dt = 0.5*dr machine-checked on all 12 rows; the E1 dt=0.025 runs reproduce the filed dr=0.05 errors bitwise), while protocol section 3.4 defines a spatial measurement as fixed dt=1e-4 and says dt~h runs are never quoted as spatial. C5: no filed numerics study uses a constant dt<=1e-3, so the protocol's own spatial methodology was never executed on the filed evidence. E1: at fixed dr=0.05, refining dt moves the error by 22.4% (lffd), 41.8% (cnfd) and 143.4% (cnfem) per measurement - far above the 2% subdominance threshold; for lffd and cnfem the error INCREASES as dt is refined (3.20e-4 -> 4.10e-4 and 1.17e-4 -> 3.83e-4), the signature of cancellation between temporal and spatial error at cfl=0.5. E3/decomposition: at dr=0.1 the cfl=0.5 errors are 0.77x / 2.26x / 0.28x the dt=1e-4 errors for lffd / cnfd / cnfem, so the filed study does not even measure the right magnitude, let alone a spatial order. E2: a protocol-style fixed dt=1e-3 study at dr=0.2/0.1/0.05 does yield order 2.000/1.999/2.001 for the three schemes, so the order-2 conclusion is recoverable and is not in dispute - the defect is that the filed evidence does not establish it as spatial. Therefore worker-067's F1 textual finding is confirmed AND its mitigation ('no number changes, scope the text') is refuted as stated: the fix is not text-only, it needs the fixed-dt study filed as the order evidence (or the claim rescoped to mixed order), with the cfl=0.5 study kept as a supporting control. This also withdraws worker-081's own W081-N0-C8-01 accept at the same protocol hash; a revise verdict is the honest one.
constructive_remedy: file the fixed-dt study (E2: dt=1e-3 at dr=0.2/0.1/0.05, all three schemes, order 2.000/1.999/2.001) as the order-certification evidence, extended to four rungs (add dr=0.025) and/or dt=1e-4 where affordable (E3: 60000 steps, lffd 0.6s, cnfd 17s, cnfem 16s per rung)
keep the cfl=0.5 4-rung study as a labelled mixed-order supporting control, not as the spatial certification
amend section 3.4 in rev 4 so the admissible spatial study is exactly the fixed-dt one, and require the fixed-dr dt-refinement control for any claim that quotes a constant-CFL run
verdict.falsifier: Re-measure numerics/CONVERGENCE_PROTOCOL.md: if not 1e6cdf04d7a24313 this adjudication does not bind. It is falsified if a filed study with constant dt<=1e-3 across >=3 rungs exists (then section 3.4 describes real practice), if E1 max relative change crosses the 2% rule in the other direction on a rerun at the frozen module hash, or if numerics/tests/flat_wave_replication.py no longer hashes 8ade1cdc163ea420.
